data.name: Yvon
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ioannes, meaning 'God is gracious'. The name Yvon is a feminine variation, possibly influenced by the Latin word avis, meaning 'bird'. The name is also associated with the biblical character Jonas, who was called to be a prophet and was saved from the belly of a whale. The name is symbolic of purity, grace, and resilience.
